profile.headline: Programmer, Wearer of Funny Hats
profile.geoLocationName: New York, New York, United States
profile.summary: Master's in CS from Georgia Tech, specializing in machine learning. Animal lover, outdoor enthusiast. Trying to use software to make the world a better place.

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.description:
Sole backend engineer on a Django/Postgres app that served the farming and ranching community.

1. improved performance of web and mobile first-load api calls by ~2.5x
2. added data integrity checks and user-friendly error handling to guarantee consistency
3. developed API and interface to track annual herd performance and forage calculations
4. developed API to generate land productivity estimates based on NRCS soil database

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.description:
Promoted from Software Engineer to Lead.

Gave technical direction and individual contributions to multiple teams at Web, including:

1. template projects for quickly deploying and dockerizing new microservices
2. CI/CD setup and developer experience tooling for java/javascript/python
3. Maintenance and upgrades of auth infrastructure and microservice tooling and libraries
4. wrote UI component library

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Wrote elasticsearch queries, backend services, and frontend application for a data visualization tool. Wrote a feature generation pipeline in python/pandas for internal reporting to executive and product team on business effectiveness.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Reduced memory consumption and startup time of large C++ application

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Analyzed performance of a proposed computer architecture running DoD benchmarks, and simulated effectiveness of routing algorithms on program performance for scalable SMP machines in C++.

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description: Improved data gathering techniques and performed tests on methane combustion for future research in efficiency near the limits of combustion

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description: Performed tests on various types of tennis racket and string combinations to determine effects on spin generation and vibration. Assisted in creating a test bench and wrote Matlab code to automate data acquisition from high speed video footage.

positions.title: Team Member
positions.description: Performed maintenance and cleaning on parts for the competition racecar. Fabricated CFRP parts for use during the racing season. Assisted in designing structural members of the frame in Solidworks.

projects.title: a.Walk: Exoskeleton Knee | Mechatronics Final Project
projects.description:
The objective of this project was to prototype a knee brace component of the human exo-skeleton used to assist paraplegic patients. This project is intended as an improvement to solve three design challenges: 
1. Free extension at all times
2. Stop, damp, and free flexion with minimal interference 
3. Operable with a simple actuation

I was in charge of the sensor setup and programming for this project.
